# First Implementation File Map

- `geelooy/social-hub/styles/future-hygiene.css`
- `geelooy/social-hub/styles/future-interaction-baseline.css`
- `geelooy/social-hub/styles/mobile.css`

- `geelooy/docs/index.html` plus local style manifest/modules.
- `geelooy/drive/index.html` plus shell/layout style modules.

## Probable first rewrites after evidence

No file below is authorized solely because it appears here. It becomes a rewrite target only if the full read proves the listed debt.

- Social Hub local hygiene/interaction modules: overflow, local layers, complete state transitions.
- Social Hub `index.html`: readability and progressive disclosure while preserving IDs.
- Home `index.css`: route-root localization if naked document selectors remain.
- Docs route-local shell modules: mobile disclosure and focus hygiene.
- Drive route-local shell modules: narrow-screen pane retraction and scroll ownership.

## Verification artifacts

- Route-family browser screenshots/snapshots.
- `scrollWidth <= innerWidth` checks.
- Interactive focus/open/active state checks.
- Console/network error checks.
- Existing route tests.
- Whole-file readback and line-count checks.

## NEXT_ACTION

Read the seven Social Hub style modules named above and its main assembly selector contracts; then write only the minimum coherent set of whole-file replacements required to close actual gaps.
